archived_rollouts.issue_198_early_stop: #198 is fixed by #203 in this release. Staging could not show the early stop from outside: Cloudflare holds an unterminated chunked request body and resets it after about 15 s (fetch probe TypeError after 15192 ms; raw TLS chunked probe ECONNRESET after 15133 ms and 40053 bytes sent). The early stop is proven by tests/runtime/platform-json-body.test.ts (source cancelled before draining; declared oversize never pulled) in verify run 37630943060, and the staging json_stream_limit_413 check proves the bounded path is live.

Attempts 1 and 3 (832fd97c, 7fad4d94) crashed on unhandled pg client error events (a socket read timeout; then the exporter terminated by its own 120 s idle-in-transaction bound while pg_dump ran), so the adapter cleanup never ran and asset_maintenance_policy stayed enabled; attempt 2 failed preflight on it.
